# Public photo regression fixtures

These images test content suitability, not vitamin status. No diagnosis or demographic label is inferred. They are unchanged originals; no person endorses this project.

| File | Creator | Source / licence |
|---|---|---|

| tongue.jpg | Stephanie cheks | [Human Tongue.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Human_Tongue.jpg), [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) |

The `lips.source.json` and `nails.source.json` files retain Wikimedia's full author, original URL and licence metadata for those unchanged fixtures. Images remain under their respective licences, independently of the software licence.
